quest.title: The Surging Darkness
quest.description: Abyssal monsters invade Natlan, and the curtain rises on a massive war...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1125, Primogem x30, Mora x49200, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x9

talks.objective: Leave the Weary Inn and join the battle
Talk to Mavuika and learn more about the battle situation

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I see. I'll send reinforcements to those two locations. This other one is too dangerous — I'll handle it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The remaining locations are remote, with no inhabitants. Let's bring our warriors back, and make sure they're careful on the retreat.

dialogues.speaker: Tumpis
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll spread the word.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: We're here. What's going on? Kachina said the Abyss attacked again?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yes. It's not looking good. Our forces have always been able to handle the sporadic attacks, but now, there are more monsters than ever, and the attacks are more frequent.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: What about the scale? What areas are they targeting?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: All of Natlan. Not just around the Stadium, but even the remote areas of the Collective of Plenty are reporting attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Could this also be some kind of omen? If things continue like this, then—

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: We won't last much longer, I know... What we're seeing now is the desperation of the Abyss. It knows we're only one hero short.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I don't have the strength to fight it right now. This is its best opportunity, and its final chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're saying... We just have to hold out for as long as we can?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It'll be a long fight. Our current focus needs to be on protecting civilians and conserving manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: There are caravans and adventurers trapped in the wild. Many of our warriors have already left to rescue them, but they'll need reinforcements.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Leave that to us. We'll head out right away.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Alright. Xilonen, Kachina — head to the camp near the Children of Echoes. Citlali — you're needed in the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: As an important figure in the plan, Ororon will stay here. Your tribe is too far from the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll leave right away.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I prepared a hot air balloon to take you where you're needed.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Messengers from the Scions of the Canopy are traveling all around Natlan. Update them once you've completed your mission, and they'll compile the information into a battle report.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: As I receive intel from the various regions, I'll plan your next move.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Alright, no time to lose. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Be careful, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about us? Where should we go?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I received word that a small team escorting civilians back to the Stadium was attacked. They won't be able to hold out for long.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Can I leave them to you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Thank you. The hot air balloon is over there.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wanna get some rest, Traveler? We have to head out again in a bit.

choices.text: I want to keep looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Dargo
dialogues.text: Thank you for coming. We were almost at the breaking point.

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: There were just too many monsters. They just kept coming, wave after wave. I've never seen it this bad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least we got here in time. You all should get going.

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: I know, but it's not that easy. A lot of people were hurt in the battle just now.

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: Our cart was also attacked. And now, our supplies are scattered everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Kokpon
dialogues.text: That's not important right now. We need to focus on getting out of here alive.

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: I know, but those were medical supplies. What if they need them back at the Stadium...

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: It's them! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: We came to help, but looks like you don't need it. Nice job making it through.

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Now we can head straight to the next location.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What other areas need help?

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: Here, take a look at the latest battle report.

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: Messengers from the Scions of the Canopy are traveling all around Natlan to pass along the latest intel.

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: If you see a messenger from the Scions of the Canopy, feel free to ask them about the latest battle situation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks! Now, where should we go next?

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Seems like you can hold your own in a fight, so let's split up. Choose where you want to go, and we'll take the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: Still looks like they could use some help here, though. These supplies are really important. What should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: It's alright. Don't delay your rescue efforts on our account.

dialogues.speaker: Dargo
dialogues.text: But, if we stay here too long, the monsters might come back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Should we stay and help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon will do whatever you decide!

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot

dialogues.speaker: Asiri
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. I've updated the intel on this area. I'll start spreading the word.

dialogues.speaker: Asiri
dialogues.text: Hang in there, you two. A lot of places still need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: The situation is still quite grim. Here, take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Looks like this place also isn't as safe as we thought. That, plus the bridge to the Stadium is also compromised.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah, what's going on!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's an Abyssal Pylon!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The rabble-rousers return. They don't know when to give up.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: An Abyssal Pylon, here... That's not good news. We need to deal with it, now.

talks.objective: Talk to the warriors stationed here

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Phew, thank you so much! You came just in time.

dialogues.speaker: Waqar
dialogues.text: What's going on? Were other places hit?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it seems like it.

dialogues.speaker: Waqar
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon told us to be ready to evacuate. She warned us something like this could happen, but I never thought there would be this many monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Wayta
dialogues.text: You got here just in time, but what should we do about the wounded...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The wounded?

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: This area was hit bad. We're housing the wounded in this house for now, but we're short on medicine. It's not easy for them to get around, either.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: We don't know what to do next. We're sitting ducks if we stay here, but we can't just leave them behind.

dialogues.speaker: Waqar
dialogues.text: Thank goodness you're here, though. You saved us all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should move them to the Scions of the Canopy while you have the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: You're right. The monsters are gone, so it should be safe for now. Some of my men can escort them.

dialogues.speaker: Wayta
dialogues.text: That will take time, though, and some of the wounded can't walk. They might have to stay here...

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Once we escort the first group, I'll call for reinforcements. That way, everyone can evacuate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's help them out here for now. Then, we can head to the next area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a messenger over there. Don't forget — we can get the latest intel from them.

talks.objective: Talk to the courier to obtain battlefield intel
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two! Thanks again for rescuing me.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: You know each other?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we ran into him out in the wild. He was injured, but luckily, some saurians took him back to safety... Uh, speaking of which, are you sure you've recovered enough to be out and about like this?

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: Haha, I got really lucky — my injuries were just some flesh wounds. The doctor said they should heal on their own as long as I get enough rest, so I figured I'd try and keep working if I could.

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: But, uh, it didn't take me long to start regretting that decision... Everything's hurting now. As soon as I've delivered this battle report, I'm heading right back to go lie down.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Sounds sensible. It's not a good idea to be taking risks while you're injured.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah, what's going on!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's an Abyssal Pylon!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The rabble-rousers return. They don't know when to give up.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: An Abyssal Pylon, here... That's not good news. We need to deal with it, now.

talks.objective: Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot
Try to evacuate the Saurians from the area

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's alright! You're safe now! The bad guys are all gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go and find your friends, okay? It's dangerous out here. It's best to stick together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think they understood that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, then... Shoo! Shoo! C'mon... Shoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope, still nothing... Wait! There's something on the ground over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Oh! It's one of the battle reports from the Scions of the Canopy. This must be what the saurians were trying to protect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks pretty recent, too. We can use it to figure out where to go next.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right! Maybe they just dropped it by accident, though...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, um, we saw the battle report, so you guys don't need to worry anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, still no response...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what do you want to do? Follow the battle report? Or continue to explore this area?

choices.text: The messenger might still be nearby.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to the warriors stationed here

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Thank you for coming... We finally have time to catch our breath.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation with the Children of Echoes?

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Fairly stable, for now. We've stationed ourselves here to act as a buffer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about the monsters that suddenly appeared?

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Based on my experience, the monsters are attracted to two things — the presence of living beings and combat.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: That's why we set up our front line of defense so far from the tribe. The civilians are more isolated from combat that way.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Ah, the messenger's here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Perfect! We were just waiting for the latest battle report.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Mhm, we'll stay here and continue to guard the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: There's so much that needs to be done after that last battle, but we're short on manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: If you're not in a hurry to leave, would you be willing to help out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's a decision for {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Talk to the courier to obtain battlefield intel

dialogues.speaker: Ullanta
dialogues.text: Here's the current situation — people from all over Natlan are trying to make their way to the Stadium, but they're being targeted by the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Ullanta
dialogues.text: If you have the strength, they could really use some help.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're The Captain's soldiers, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: Yes. Per his order, we're now under the Pyro Archon's command.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: Not everyone understood his decision, but our lord's orders take precedence over all.

dialogues.speaker: Kamaka
dialogues.text: We're alive because of them! They saved us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, um, guess that means we should thank you guys... Ah, this feels weird.

dialogues.speaker: Guselnikov
dialogues.text: Agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: Where are you headed? The People of the Springs?

dialogues.speaker: Kamaka
dialogues.text: That was the plan, but I don't know if it's safe anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: I suggest heading to the Stadium. Most of the manpower will be focused there, so it'll be safer than staying with the tribes.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: Once we take care of these monsters, some of our soldiers will escort you.

dialogues.speaker: Kamaka
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess a little extra help never hurts.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: People from all over Natlan are heading to the Stadium. That area needs to be the center of our defensive efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: If your other tasks are complete, I'm sure the people there could use your aid.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the intel.

dialogues.speaker: Stadukhin
dialogues.text: ...Hearing those words from you also feels quite strange for me. But, I can only accept the situation at hand.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Kinich! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Yeah, thought I would check on the situation after finishing my delivery work. If you're here, though, I doubt I'm needed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It really feels like we are running short on people everywhere. It's so dangerous out there. Just when we think everything's under control, another thing goes off the deep end...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not that Paimon's complaining. It's just.. what if things get even worse?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: *scoff* What a stupid question. You know the answer, you're just too afraid to face it... like a puny bug clinging to a pipe dream.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, that's enough out of you!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: *sigh* This may be one of the few times Ajaw has a point.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: On the bright side, we can pat ourselves on the back for saving all these civilians, and bringing them here.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: My tribe is launching a second wave of patrols soon. We'll do a scan of the whole nation. As long as we don't scatter our forces, the Abyss is nothing to fear.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Fear is useless, anyway. Even if the endless surge of monsters scares you to death, you still have to fight. There's no other choice.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where is Mavuika?

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: She took a small team of warriors to the mines. A group of people from the Children of Echoes were trapped there. I think she just got back.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: The lava alone makes that area dangerous, and now it's crawling with monsters. Without her power, she's just an ordinary Vision-bearer like the rest of us. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Spewing nonsense, as always... Quit worrying and look at the outcome, genius! She's still obviously the strongest warrior you have.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! She always seems so confident. Plus, she told us you can only become the Archon by proving your strength.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: It's true. She certainly helps us save manpower. She can handle the dangerous areas almost entirely on her own.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Alright, alright. I'm tired of this conversation. Either take a break or get moving already!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: A break sounds good. We won't be much help in the field if we're dead on our feet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea. Maybe we can see if the people around here need anything in the meantime?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Even on our break, we can still be helpful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, looks like we're on the same page.

talks.objective: Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What was that?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The physical embodiment of pure dread and destruction! Hahaha, that black pit of despair will eat you all alive! Ah, at long last!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha." Laugh all you want, it's gonna eat you too!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: So is that the source of the Abyss's power?

choices.text: It emitted a huge amount of Abyssal energy.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: I have to get a closer look at that thing. It may already be too late...

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Get to the place mentioned in the battle report — I have a feeling things are about to get very bad very quickly. There's no time to lose!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The fact that deadpan Kinich is this nervous just goes to show how serious this really is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go. The disaster's really happening...

choices.text: This is a full-scale invasion of Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Dargo
dialogues.text: Let's take a moment to regroup. Who knows when the monsters will show up again...

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: These supplies are very important. It would be a huge waste to lose them...

dialogues.speaker: Kokpon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fine, I'll help you. Let's round them up and get packing.

dialogues.speaker: Pumpu
dialogues.text: If you see a messenger from the Scions of the Canopy, feel free to ask them about the latest battle situation.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: What's the situation at the tribal camp?

dialogues.speaker: Wayta
dialogues.text: Safe, for now. Although, most people are out delivering intel. If the Abyss launches a large-scale attack in the meantime...

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Then... it will fall to us to protect the tribe. What, you scared?

dialogues.speaker: Wayta
dialogues.text: Not a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Wisa
dialogues.text: No! I don't wanna go! I wanna stay with you!

dialogues.speaker: Auki
dialogues.text: Mommy can't go with you, my dear. She's hurt. Still, it's going to be okay. These nice people are gonna take you to safety. Then, they'll come back for me.

dialogues.speaker: Wisa
dialogues.text: No! I won't go!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw is trying to rest. Cease your racket at once, lowly creatures. We shall take no comments on the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: No one asked.

dialogues.speaker: Waqar
dialogues.text: That was terrifying... At least we made it through.

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: Just stay calm... Time to be brave...

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: You're a warrior. It's your job to protect people...

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: This uniform brings back a lot of memories. Been a while since I last wore it.

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: But, hey... Still fits like a glove!

dialogues.speaker: Guselnikov
dialogues.text: The Captain was right. The situation is not looking good. Just look at the amount of people we've had to rescue.

dialogues.speaker: Guselnikov
dialogues.text: We shouldn't linger. We'll get these people back on the road, then head to our next destination.

dialogues.speaker: Kamaka
dialogues.text: Saved by the Fatui... Now that's lucky...

dialogues.speaker: Andinet
dialogues.text: The protection of this location is critical. Our current forces won't be enough. We need reinforcements.

dialogues.speaker: Tewodros
dialogues.text: I'm sure other areas are thinking the exact same thing...

dialogues.speaker: Maticui
dialogues.text: *panting*... That's it. I need a break.

dialogues.speaker: Icmotza
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm terrified... The monsters aren't gonna show up here... right?

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: It's you two! I'm so glad you're alright!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You made it back!

dialogues.speaker: Kokpon
dialogues.text: Sure did. Dargo made sure we got back safely before rushing out again.

dialogues.speaker: Ardra
dialogues.text: Plus, we managed to deliver the medical supplies to the Stadium. I really can't thank you enough for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Diligent Yumkasaur
dialogues.text: No going outside. It's too dangerous. That goes for you too!

dialogues.speaker: Valiant Tepetlisaur
dialogues.text: Thanks for saving us, human. The next time those pesky monsters show up, I'll fight them off!

dialogues.speaker: Ackon
dialogues.text: The commissions just keep coming one after another. Normally I'd be happy, but given the circumstances...

dialogues.speaker: Botwe
dialogues.text: It's only a "commission" if you get paid. This is something else entirely.

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: Still, everyone's doing their part. There's more to adventuring than commission fees. Anyone can be an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Botwe
dialogues.text: Except those who like to play it safe.

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: Nice work out there. This is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: Don't forget to refuel, or you won't have enough strength when it counts!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! They must be trapped! Let's go help!

dialogues.speaker: Dargo
dialogues.text: Reinforcements! Thank goodness!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The battle report said a lot of monsters appeared around here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, see the people fighting those monsters? Is that the Fatui!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, there are so many people here! Looks like it really is getting too dangerous for people to stay out in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess that means the situation isn't getting any better... Well, we'll just have to keep fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is it! Looks like a battle is in progress. Let's go help them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we're off! Hey, this thing is pretty convenient!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not only fast, but also saves us a lot of energy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are a lot of people in here. Could they all be refugees?
